crime: A friend noticed that whenever a room's arrangement was unfamiliar, {WITCH_NAME} paused before taking a seat. In private, she explained that she first pictured every route by which a loose object could reach her, then rehearsed her response to each one.

The next day at lunch, the friend moved a spoon around the dishes. Pointing at {WITCH_NAME}, the friend told the other girls that the spoon was tracing an attack route, then repeated the private explanation when they asked what the joke meant.

During evening free time, {WITCH_NAME} asked the friend to speak with her in the lounge. They met with no one else in the room. The next girl to enter found the friend's body beside a sofa and one of the lounge swords beyond its far end. The cut across the throat had severed the major blood vessels and airway; her breathing and pulse had stopped from blood loss.

At first, it seemed that someone had cut the friend's throat with the communal sword and left it elsewhere in the lounge. But a curved line of blood drops ran from the neck wound around the sofa to the blade. Along the bend, the sword had struck neither the floor, the wall, nor the sofa.
The prisoners also found a strand caught between the hilt wrapping and the guard. It matched the cuff of {WITCH_NAME}'s assigned clothes, which were visibly distinct from everyone else's.

The blade could only have picked up that blood at the wound, so the drops recorded its movement after the cut. Neither a throw nor a carried sword could make that continuous, unsupported turn. Trajectory Control accounted for the curve, while the trapped strand identified her as the person who had held the sword before its flight. {WITCH_NAME} had fully pictured the curve, then used her power on the handheld sword, making it follow that single continuous path across the friend's throat and around the sofa.
fields.epitaph: Every danger had a path she could trace. The one that came from beside her had none.
fields.epithet: A Confidence for the Whole Table
execution: A thick iron hood drops over her entire head and locks around the tops of her shoulders. Its walls press against her face, jaw, and skull, blocking sight and sound.

No object approaches her from outside. Instead, the iron contracts inward from every side, crushing her jaw and skull and compressing her upper neck until her skull and neck break and her breathing and pulse stop.

magic.name: Trajectory Control
magic.text: She can make an object follow an imagined path.
